prompt: A plant is $4$ cm tall and grows $3$ cm each week: $h = 4 + 3w$. How tall is it after $5$ weeks?
hint: Start at $4$ (that is $b$), then MOVE up $3$ for each of the $5$ weeks.

hints.text: Start at $4$ (that is $b$), then MOVE up $3$ for each of the $5$ weeks.

alternativeExplanations.title: Week by week
steps: After week $5$ the plant is $19$ cm — same as $4 + 3 \times 5$.
